input.summary: Settled 1 of 15 controls from clear habit evidence: kb_left_shift (Sprint) bound to a held triple puff with delay_on 500/16000, matching 32% of their profiles at more than double the next option. The remaining 14 controls were asked about rather than settled: kb_w, kb_a, kb_s, kb_left_control, kb_f, kb_i, and kb_z each had multiple close or split historical choices for a known Cyberpunk job, so the person was offered their own top options to pick from. kb_q, kb_c, dpad_N, dpad_S, kb_e, kb_f1, and kb_h have no confirmed function in this game's sourced control list and, other than a couple of controls, little or no binding history to lean on — the person was asked what each does here and given evidenced options where any existed, or a neutral pair of soft sip/puff options where there was no history at all. No control was bound without either solid habit evidence or a question back to them.
